title: Boots & Whiskey Condo Downtown
description:
Welcome to your Nashville getaway! This modern 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo is located in the heart of Downtown, just steps from Broadway’s live music, incredible dining, and local attractions. Perfect for couples, solo travelers, or business guests looking for comfort, convenience, and a touch of Southern charm. Bright and stylishly decorated with music city charm
Comfortable queen bed , Fully stocked kitchen, Smart TV + fast Wi-Fi, 
Large private balcony, Free garage Parking

Other things to note
FAQ
➤ How far is Broadway?
About 1.2 miles, an easy 5-minute drive or 20-minute walk.
➤ Is parking included?
Yes, free secure garage parking is provided on-site.
➤ What building amenities are included?
Guests have access to the resort-style pool, fitness center, and BBQ area.

Other Notes
– Downtown location—occasional city noise may be heard
– Quiet hours: 10PM–7AM
– No parties or smoking
– Exterior security cameras monitor entry and garage areas for safety
– Pool open seasonally; gym open year-round

🚧 We're Tuning Up! 🚧
Our building is currently tuning things up with renovations, so you may hear a little extra "background music" from construction during daytime hours. While we know this isn't part of the playlist, these improvements are temporary and will help make the property even better. We appreciate your understanding and are unable to offer refunds or compensation for construction-related noise or activity.
